name: Florida

officialList.label: Division of Elections' official candidate list

sampleBallot.label: Division of Elections voter lookup (then your county Supervisor of Elections for your sample ballot)

senateNotUp: Not on the ballot this year. Florida state senators serve four-year terms; the 20 even-numbered districts are elected in 2026 and the odd-numbered ones in 2028.
houseNotOnBallot: Not on the November ballot. Every House seat was up in 2026, but this one was settled earlier: only one candidate qualified, or a primary decided it with no general-election opponent.
otherRacesNote: Supreme Court justices and appeals court judges up for retention, county offices, school board, city and special-district races and local questions may also be on your ballot. Your county Supervisor of Elections has your exact sample ballot.
senateNote: Ashley Moody was appointed in January 2025 when Marco Rubio became U.S. Secretary of State; this race fills the last two years of that term. Rick Scott's seat is not up until 2030.
congressNote: These are the new district lines Florida drew in 2026, used for this election. The member named was elected in 2024 under the old map, so the area they represent today may be different.
